Schlichting2014.note: Schlichting, Zeithamova & Preston 2014 Hippocampus. Grayscale everyday objects; 72 AB + 72 BC pairs (sequence_length = total pairs), 3 s each, seen once. AB block always preceded its BC block; tests interleaved after each study scan, so the effective list before each test is shorter than 144. 2AFC with a familiar foil from another triad. Values are means (SEM ~.025-.034).
